description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for handling search filter parameters related to actionable reviews within the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties for employee numbers, reviewer employee numbers, inclusion criteria, and statuses, along with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Dashboard\\Dto\ActionableReviewSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for encapsulating search filter parameters related to actionable reviews in the Dashboard plugin. It includes filters for employee numbers, reviewer numbers, inclusion criteria, and statuses.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number concerning the filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the filter.

methods.name: getReviewerEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the reviewer employee number if set.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the inclusion criteria string for employees.

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the inclusion criteria string for employees.

methods.name: getActionableStatuses
methods.description: Returns the array of actionable statuses, if set.

methods.name: setActionableStatuses
methods.description: Sets the array of actionable statuses.

methods.name: getSelfReviewStatuses
methods.description: Returns the array of self-review statuses.

methods.name: setSelfReviewStatuses
methods.description: Sets the array of self-review statuses.
